name: daw-helper
description: A small browser toolbox for home recording: tuner for guitar, bass, banjo, ukulele, strings and custom tunings with reference tones, tap tempo and metronome, a recorder with a gain-staging meter, a plain-words recording check, and a sound lab for playing with tones, intervals and chords in synthesised sounds and sketching chord progressions exported as WAV, stems or MIDI, built for audio interfaces.
